en: Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai asking his five students a question; Rabbi Elazar ben Arach answering with a hand on his heart, a soft golden glow around the heart area.

ctx: רבי אלעזר בן ערך: לב טוב
en: Five young sages going out into the countryside to think, each looking at something different: an eye-shaped sunrise, a friend, a neighbor's house, a seedling — symbols of the answers.

ctx: רבי אלעזר בן ערך: מעשה המרכבה והאש מן השמים
en: Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai riding a donkey on a country road, his student Rabbi Elazar ben Arach walking beside him leading the donkey.

ctx: רבי אלעזר בן ערך: מעשה המרכבה והאש מן השמים
en: Both sages sitting under a tree in a field while gentle heavenly fire (soft golden flames, not burning) surrounds the trees, which seem to sing; awe and holiness, no figures in the fire.

ctx: רבי עקיבא: החדר האביק והמים החיים
en: Rabbi Akiva's great study hall with thousands of students on long benches; one empty seat stands out.

ctx: רבי עקיבא: החדר האביק והמים החיים
en: Rabbi Akiva, an elderly sage, rolling up his sleeves inside a small dusty dark room, opening the window, students carrying water and sweeping, a sick young student lying on a bed.

ctx: רבי עקיבא: החדר האביק והמים החיים
en: The sick student sitting up smiling, color back in his face, sunlight and fresh air filling the clean room, Rabbi Akiva beside him.
An empty study hall with long empty wooden benches and scattered scrolls, a lone elderly Rabbi Akiva sitting in sorrow — the students are gone.
Rabbi Akiva, very old, walking south along a desert road with a staff, determined, toward a small village at sunrise.
Rabbi Akiva wrapped in a tallit teaching just five young students in a small courtyard, faces glowing with love of Torah; the light seems to spread across the hills.
Four sages standing at the gate of a mystical luminous orchard (a garden of light, symbolic), only Rabbi Akiva walking calmly and peacefully inside; dreamlike, reverent.
A small jar of golden honey on a wooden table beside an open scroll — a gentle still-life about learning step by step, in the right measure.
